title: bassovia stenoloba

It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, and research has confirmed its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
